_note: Genes whose phenotype depends on structural variation. Only the owner edits. Every row needs a quoted source.
_statement: Meyar does not report a phenotype for these genes from a VCF. They arrive through PharmCAT's outside-call file from a caller that can see copy number, or they are reported as not assessed.

rows.justification: PharmCAT documentation: 'we do NOT recommend calling CYP2D6 from VCF' because of 'the large influence of structural variation (SV) and copy number variation (CNV) on inferring CYP2D6 phenotype'; 'CYP2D6 UMs cannot be called using only SNPs and INDELs in a VCF file'; and 'missing the copy number of a normal or decreased function allele can misrepresent a normal metabolizer (NM)'.
rows.matcherBehaviour: PharmCAT NamedAlleleMatcher: 'does not currently support structural variants, including gene copy number. If structural variants are detected in the VCF data, it will be ignored and a warning will be issued.'
rows.requiredInput: WGS BAM/CRAM with a CNV-aware caller, or a lab report
rows.roadmapCallerNote: PharmCAT names StellarPGx only for demonstration (WGS CRAM/BAM) and strongly discourages WES or low-coverage WGS to call CYP2D6.
rows.independentConfirmation: Goljan et al., PLoS ONE 2022;17(1):e0263137 excluded CYP2D6 from an 11,889-person Saudi study: 'we were not able to call star alleles with whole gene deletions, duplications or hybrids ... Accordingly, we did not include CYP2D6 in our analysis.'
